evidence_class: small paired early-decision batch; not a general reliability estimate

tasks.prompt: Open the Analytic Items page that lists costs and revenues for margin analysis. Do not open an individual record and do not modify anything.
tasks.skill: The requested read-only screen is Analytic Items. Its exact application path is /odoo/action-analytic.account_analytic_line_action_entries. Open that collection and stop without opening a record.

tasks.prompt: In this deployed application, what does a negative discount in a pricelist formula mean? Answer briefly and do not modify anything.
tasks.source_query_hint: negative discount means markup price rule
tasks.skill: For a pricelist formula, a negative discount means a markup: it increases the price rather than reducing it.

tasks.prompt: Why can this deployed version refuse to confirm a quotation when one line has no product? State the exact kind of line that triggers the refusal and the relevant exception. Do not modify anything.
tasks.source_query_hint: confirm quotation each normal line needs product
tasks.skill: Confirmation is refused when any ordinary order line has no product. A section or note line (a line with display_type) does not trigger it, and a down-payment line is also excluded. The rule is implemented by sale.order._confirmation_error_message.

tasks.prompt: List the selectable sales order Status values in this deployed version. Is locking a fifth Status value? Do not modify anything.
tasks.source_query_hint: sale order states quotation sent sales order cancelled locked separate
tasks.skill: The selectable Status values are Quotation, Quotation Sent, Sales Order, and Cancelled. Locking is separate behavior and is not a fifth value of the Status selection.

tasks.prompt: List every selectable invoice Payment Status value declared by this deployed version. Do not modify anything.
tasks.source_query_hint: invoice payment status not paid partial reversed blocked legacy
tasks.skill: The Payment Status selection declares: Not Paid, In Payment, Paid, Partially Paid, Reversed, Blocked, and Invoicing App Legacy.

tasks.prompt: List every selectable sales order Invoice Status value declared by this deployed version. Do not modify anything.
tasks.source_query_hint: sales order invoice status upselling nothing to invoice
tasks.skill: The sales order Invoice Status selection declares: Upselling Opportunity, Fully Invoiced, To Invoice, and Nothing to Invoice.

tasks.prompt: Open the Products page using the visible application interface. Do not open an individual product and do not modify anything.
tasks.skill: Use the visible Odoo application interface to open the Products collection, then stop without opening a product.
